$comment: Parent issues and their sub-issues. Applied by scripts/issue-groups.mjs; see its header. Each issue belongs to at most one group. `standalone` lists open issues left out of every group on purpose, so the script stops reporting them as ungrouped.

groups.title: Database outage fallbacks
groups.summary: What the site serves, writes or claims while the database cannot answer, and readers that cannot tell an empty table from an unreachable one.

groups.title: Adoption and pet status guards
groups.summary: Where an animal's status decides what a visitor or coordinator may do, and the places that let a refused or archived animal through.

groups.title: Admin pet form and birth dates
groups.summary: The admin pet form, the birth-date migration, and how dates are validated and defaulted in the admin dialogs.

groups.title: Public pet gallery and site navigation
groups.summary: The public gallery's filters and URL state, the pet profile page, and the site navigation.

groups.title: Language and site copy
groups.summary: Malay and English rendering, the translation dictionary, and copy that contradicts what staff can edit.

groups.title: Bulletins
groups.summary: Bulletin bylines, the seeded launch notices, and the stored Malay text nothing shows.

groups.title: Admin accounts after the role sweep
groups.summary: Admin console and staff account loose ends recorded, not fixed, by the role dead-end sweep (#144).

groups.title: Donations, receipts and sponsor portal
groups.summary: General donations and their receipts, follow-ups from #109, and the sponsor portal.

groups.title: Production secrets, deploys and CI
groups.summary: Boot-time secrets, encrypted environment files, what production and previews actually run, and CI settings not yet observed.
